name: atlas-workspace
description: Atlas, the developer platform for everyone: Rust workspace, Atlas Desktop (Tauri + SvelteKit) and the website

scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --all && cd apps/desktop && bun run format
scripts.desktop:dev: bun scripts/sh.ts scripts/setup.sh --quiet && cargo build -q -p atlas-cli && cd crates/atlas-desktop && ATLAS_HOSTD_DIR="$HOME/.atlas/dev" ATLAS_BIN="$PWD/../../target/debug/atlas" cargo tauri dev --config tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.desktop:build: bun scripts/sh.ts scripts/setup.sh --quiet && cd crates/atlas-desktop && cargo tauri build --ci
scripts.desktop:build:app: bun scripts/sh.ts scripts/setup.sh --quiet && export APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY="$(sh scripts/dev-signing-identity.sh)" && cd crates/atlas-desktop && cargo tauri build --debug --bundles app --ci --config tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.desktop:build:debug: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd apps/desktop && ATLAS_PSEUDO_LOCALE=1 bun run --cwd apps/desktop build && TAURI_CONFIG="$(cat crates/atlas-desktop/tauri.dev.conf.json)" cargo build -p atlas-desktop --features tauri/custom-protocol && touch target/debug/.atlas-desktop-bundled
scripts.mobile:beta: cd apps/mobile && bundle exec fastlane beta
scripts.desktop:check: cd apps/desktop && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
scripts.site:dev: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run dev
scripts.site:build: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.site:check: cd site && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
scripts.release:test: bun run i18n:install && bun test scripts --timeout 120000 && bun scripts/sh.ts scripts/py.sh -m unittest scripts/test_generate_manifest.py && bun scripts/sh.ts scripts/test-bootstrap-channel.sh && bun scripts/sh.ts scripts/test-labels.sh
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/desktop test && bun run release:test
